rec.title: Where the change in revenue came from, by region
rec.subtitle: Total revenue, 2024-01 to 2024-12 against 2025-01 to 2025-12: each region's contribution to the change
rec.supports: Change in the monthly total of revenue, latest 12 months against the 12 before
rec.why: The goal asks what moved revenue; region is the one category the breakdown can use.
rec.summary: Total revenue went from 128,256 in the 12 months before to 152,214 in the latest 12 months, a change of +23,958 (part of a change graded WATCH; not graded itself). East contributed +16,220 and North +7,116; West (+330) and South (+292) barely moved. Where the change sits, not what caused it.
rec.source: Scenario items on the rows the engine kept (2024-01 to 2025-12); their monthly totals match the engine's own charted series
